jobs.description: Company DescriptionAbout us:Passion for food. Hunger for tech. We make METRO digital.Today technology is driving the world. And at METRO.digital we are driving the technology for one of the leading international wholesalers specializing in food - METRO. From e-commerce to checkout, to delivery software, we work on a wide range of products to make each day a success for our customers and colleagues. With passion and ownership, we build the future of wholesale.You are driving to create smart solutions for customers around the globe? You want to grow in a flexible environment? Let the right career opportunity find you and join us!How you will make an impact?The main objective of the LUCA program is to successfully upgrade METRO’s Finance to SAP S/4HANA to ensure business continuity and avoid security and compliance risks. The LUCA program is, in addition, a critical enabler of METRO’s strategy to achieve standardization, harmonization, and centralization.As a Technical Architect within the LUCA program, you will design and implement SAP finance solutions to optimize financial processes, review business requirements to deliver effective and standardized solutions. You will have a focus on Subledgers, namely on Account Receivable processes. Thus, the role requires deep expertise in SAP’s subledgers modules such as AR, AP, SD and Serrala’s Autobank solution, combined with hands-on experience in implementation and application support.Job DescriptionYour Responsibilities:- Collaborate with finance, process, and IT teams to convert requirements into practical technical designs;- Lead project rollouts solutioning of business requirements, from solution design to implementation, while analyzing complex changes and troubleshooting issues;- Ensure solutions align with Metro’s global template, enterprise architecture, SAP best practices, and compliance standards;- Simplify and convey technical concepts to diverse audiences, including executives, business users, and technical teams;- Oversee SI partner delivery by reviewing and approving requirements refinement, high level and detailed design documents, transports, customizing documentation.QualificationsRequired key competencies and qualifications:- Bachelor’s/Master’s in Business Informatics, Computer Science, or related field, with strong knowledge of Financial Accounting and Indirect Procurement;- 10+ years in SAP AP, AR, SD, with familiarity in SAP Fiori and SAP Business Technology Platform and Serrala’s Autobank as a plus;- Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills;- Finance-related SAP certifications are advantageous;- Retail industry experience preferred for tailored SAP solutions;- Excellent English proficiency (written and spoken);- Willingness and ability to travel as required.Additional InformationWhat we offer at METRO.digital?- Hybrid and agile work: thrive in a flexible, multicultural environment.At METRO.digital, we promote work-life balance through a hybrid working model. You’ll be part of self-organizing, multicultural teams that collaborate in an agile setup.- People development: when you grow so do we!We want you to become the best version of yourself with individual and company-wide programs and trainings for people development. Focused among other on development, leadership, appreciation ... it´s time to upskill your career.- Support with individual solutions: we are people-caring!We offer support whenever you need it - at every stage of your professional journey.Want to know more about all our benefits? Discover more here (https://metro.digital/about/life-at-metro) .Let´s connect soon. Apply for the role now!Position grade within our career framework: Technical Architect Grade 1 (Md8).

About UsAt Deutsche Telekom, we don’t just connect people; we build the cognitive digital infrastructure of the future. Within our Group Technology – Technology Vendor Portfolio Management unit, we steer the high-impact alliances that drive next-generation innovation. As networks transform into self-optimizing, cloud-native ecosystems, we are embedding artificial intelligence and automation into our core infrastructure.Are you a visionary strategist who understands how AI and next-gen telecom tech converge? Do you have the executive presence to operate alongside industry leaders? Join us and lead our technology partner ecosystem into the age of intelligent connectivity.Your Responsibilities: What You Will DoAs a Senior Partner Manager (m/w/d), you will take full ownership of relationship building and lifecycle management at the C-level and Top-Management level, both internally across the DT Group and externally with global tech leaders.- Executive Relationship & C-Level Management: Act as the primary strategic interface, establishing and nurturing high-impact relationships with executive stakeholders and C-level counterparts.- AI-Driven Infrastructure Innovation: Define future demand by identifying joint search fields, advanced automation use cases, and AI-centric network initiatives.- Matrix & Cross-Group Project Responsibility: Take end-to-end project and program leadership for large-scale partner initiatives—from high-stakes negotiation to commercialization and retirement. You will steer complex, virtual, and international project teams across the global DT Group without direct disciplinary responsibility.- Commercial & Financial Governance: Develop robust business plans, align complex financial planning activities, set up partner governance, and define KPIs to ensure mutual success.- Performance Monitoring: Drive executive-level steering presentations, closely monitor target achievement, and coordinate the internal rollout of partner products.Your Profile: What You BringYou are a highly analytical professional who bridges the gap between complex network technology, business economics, and future-ready AI applications.Qualifications & Core Experience:- Education: A university degree (Master's or equivalent) in Electrical Engineering, Communication Engineering, Economics, Computer Science, or a comparable qualification.- Track Record: At least 7 to 10 years of proven professional experience in Strategic Partner Management, Alliance Management, or Tech Procurement within the telecommunications sector.- Telecom Infrastructure Expertise: Deep, long-standing experience in partner management for network infrastructures, including Mobile (5G/6G), Fixed-Line, IP & Transport, Core Network, Service Platforms, and Cloud, specifically mapping to Deutsche Telekom's ecosystem.- Future-Tech Literacy: A strong understanding of the business potential of Artificial Intelligence, machine learning applications in networking, and automation trends, allowing you to identify cutting-edge tech trends.Skills & Competencies:- Virtual Team Steering: Exceptional track record in organizing, motivating, and leading large-scale programs within virtual, international, and matrixed teams across multiple corporate stakeholders.- Agile & Classic Cooperation: Mastery of both classical and agile project management methodologies to coordinate cross-functional programs.- Intercultural Competence: Extensive experience navigating international business landscapes and managing senior executive relationships across diverse cultures.- Analytical Power: Outstanding conceptual and analytical skills with a collaborative, solution-oriented working style.- **Languages: **Fluency in German and English (written and spoken) is mandatory for this high-level role.What We Offer (Why Deutsche Telekom?)- Hybrid Work: Flexible working hours and state-of-the-art mobile working options based out of our headquarters in Bonn.- AI & Tech Innovation: Work at the absolute forefront of network intelligence, automation, and infrastructure evolution.- High-Level Exposure: Drive visibility at the top-management level across one of Europe’s leading telco providers.- Compensation & Benefits: Highly competitive salary package, extensive company pension scheme, and employee discounts on Telekom products.Ready to connect?We look forward to receiving your application! Please submit your CV and cover letter online via our career portal.Your contact: anyue.gao@telekom.deDeutsche Telekom is an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and look forward to receiving applications from all qualified individuals, regardless of gender, nationality, ethnic and social origin, religion, disability, or age.

Company DescriptionAt METRO, we’re more than a global food wholesaler. This means taking on responsibility, making our company your company and creating a business together that remains true to its roots but always seeks new solutions.Job DescriptionYour new role:In the global headquarters we source a selection of goods that are offered to and sold by all our country subsidiaries worldwide. For our Food category, we are currently looking for an Expert in Global Procurement Food (all genders), who brings our assortment to the next level. You analyze the international assortment, align with the sourcing teams in our countries, and derive creative and beneficial solutions. You keep close track on supplier production capacity and coverage rate and check e-sourcing status and report database (prices, volumes, supplier contracts). Lead the global relationship between international teams of strategic suppliers, Metro HQ stakeholders and various METRO country companies ensuring the suppliers perform in line with our company strategy.Where your expertise is needed:- Performance: Define, develop, negotiate, implement, and review the performance of a Global Own Brand Range in our countries.- Harmonization: Continuously align with our country subsidiaries to harmonize the product range and maximize its potential.- Process-Management: Coordinate global cross functional teams (Quality, Packaging, Supply Chain, Marketing) through a clear and pre-defined Own Brand process.- Negotiation: Analyze and compare RFQ inputs from suppliers to negotiate the best quality/price ratio.- Strategy: Negotiate global service contracts delivering conditions against services designed together with our country’s international supplier strategies and joint business plans.QualificationsWhat we are looking for:- Education: University degree (or equivalent experience) with minimum 2 years relevant work experience, preferably in buying food commodities / FMCG on an international level.- Expertise & Personality: A strong negotiator with a proven track record in category management and condition-based supplier negotiations on both local and international level and strong interest in food product development and good understanding / willingness to learn HoReCa customer needs as well as openness to be motivated to get to know the B2B Food Wholesale sector, willing to accompany the development of our Global Strategy, following our Fundamentals with problem solving capacity and analytical thinking skills.- Digital skills: Proficient knowledge of MS Office products including Word, Outlook and strong knowledge in Excel.- Communication: Good communicator, who enjoys working in teams with internal colleagues from both HQ and countries, suppliers and manufacturer being fluent in English (both written and oral).- Flexibility: Problem solving capacity and analytical thinking skills.Additional InformationWhat we offer:- Work-life balance: Flexible working hours in agreement with your line manager, 30 days of holiday.- Training: A comprehensive training offer via our own training center or externally.- Well-being: Health days with lots of health checks and information about your well-being, company medical care including a range of preventive services, such as flu shots, OTHEB employee assistance program.- Exciting life on campus: Free gym and sports classes, Rioba coffee bar, canteen with discounted meals for employees, many campus events.- Discounts: discounted Jobticket as well as discounts in our wholesale stores and at many partner companies.- Comfort: Good transport connections, free parking spaces, JobBike.- Company pension plan: You will receive a contribution to your company pension.- Family driven: Three daycare centers for children on campus, support of holiday camps for children of employees.

The team is responsible for dealing with security risks as well as possible violations of laws and regulations, both nationally and internationally. It carries out security assessments, security audits, and fraud investigations. It creates appropriate guidelines and audit mechanisms and coordinates the regional and local Security managers. In the event of suspected violations of laws or internal regulations, the team investigates the incidents and reports to the senior management. In addition, the corporate safety function ensures a safe working environment by developing and monitoring company-wide safety standards and preventive measures. The Corporate Security, Safety and Forensics team is part of the Audit, Asset Protection & Governance division. You will support the team in two areas, security and forensics.Your tasks:- Loss Prevention: Support initiatives aimed at reducing shrinkage, protecting company assets, and strengthening operational resilience.- Incident Management: Oversee and coordinate security incidents, liaising with emergency services and authorities as needed, and manage, maintain, and develop the security incident management system.- Crisis Management: Support and coordinate the crisis management process, including maintaining crisis management guidelines, designing and delivering training, and conducting security risk assessments for current and prospective operations.- Risk Assessment: Continuously monitor and evaluate evolving threat landscapes, providing recommendations to mitigate emerging risks.- policies, and perform OSINT background checks to support corporate integrity and compliance objectives.- Investigations & Event Security: Conduct fraud investigations, interviews, and analyze physical firm, in investigations, or within the security function of an international company.- Technical Skills: Proficient in MS O365 Suite, especially Excel, and ERP systems.- Languages: Very good English and German skills (both written and oral).- Personality: Team player with an accurate, analytical, and open-minded approach, complemented by a can-do attitude.- Flexibility: Willingness to adapt to The University Hospital Bonn (UKB) is one of Germany’s leading university hospitals, combining top-level performance in medicine and research with excellence in teaching. Each year, more than half a million patients receive inpatient and outpatient care at the UKB. Around 3,500 students study medicine and dentistry here, and over 600 people are trained annually in healthcare professions. With approximately 9,900 employees, the UKB is the third-largest employer in the Bonn/Rhein-Sieg region. In the Focus hospital ranking, the UKB ranks first among university hospitals in North Rhine-Westphalia and second nationwide in terms of case mix index (case severity). In 2024, the UKB raised nearly €100 million in third-party funding for research, development, and teaching. The F.A.Z. Institute has named the UKB “Germany’s Training Champion” and “Germany’s Most Attractive Employer” for the fourth consecutive year.The following full-/part-time position (38.5/19.5 hours per week)  is to be filled as soon as possible in the Institute for Hygiene and Public Health, Section Global Child Health of the University Hospital Bonn:Scientific coordinator (m/f/d)The Section of Global Child Health was established in November 2025 with the appointment of the Endowed Professorship in Global Child Health. The Section’s remit includes research and teaching in Germany and internationally, as well as clinical practice and the applied, practice-oriented engagement with global health challenges affecting children and adolescents. The professorship is structured as a tandem appointment with a corresponding position at the University of Malawi, based in Lilongwe.You will work in close collaboration with the section head in establishing sound research and communication networks with partners in Malawi and GermanyThe professorship focuses on research in the area of neonatal, child, and adolescent health in “Low and Middle Income Countries” (LMICs), identifies barriers to and solutions for improving global child health, and facilitates the transfer of epidemiological and clinical evidence into health care services with the goal of improving the health status of all children globally.It facilitates institutional, national and international networking and collaboration with universities, academic institutions and key development partners.In addition, it provides academic and health policy advice to national and international governmental as well as non-governmental organizations with regard to global child health.The position is initially limited to three years and remunerated according to TV-L EG 13 (German tax ID is a prerequisite). If you currently live abroad, you should be willing to relocate to Germany temporarily. Subject to interest and feasibility, a temporary increase in the scope of employment through third-party funded resources is envisaged.Tasks:This position offers the opportunity to actively contribute to the development of global strategies for improving children's health and to build and design a completely new international research and education structure.- Strategic coordination and management of international research, education and clinical programmes across the two professorships and the EKFS network- Planning, coordination, and monitoring of cross-institutional activities with academic and non-academic partners- Management of communication channels between institutions, disciplines, and countries, ensuring efficient information flow and alignment of activities- Coordination, and implementation of training materials and structured capacity-building programmes in collaboration with international experts- Planning, organisation, and delivery of international workshops and seminars in online and on-site formats- Preparation of annual progress and impact reports, dissemination of results through conferences and other scientific communication formats- Contribution to the strategic development, coordination, and drafting of third-party funding proposals to expand and sustain programme activitiesRequirements:- A full academic degree at Master’s level or higher in a health-related discipline- A strong interest in global child health and international health systems cooperation- Demonstrated experience in project coordination and research management- Excellent organisational skills and a structured, meticulous approach to work- Proven ability to navigate academic hierarchies and university administrative processes, combined with sensitivity to intercultural contexts- Strong teamwork skills, resilience, and the ability to assert and represent set positions- Full professional proficiency in both German and English, written and spoken Willingness to maintain an appropriate on-site presence at the university in Bonn- Previous extended study, research, or professional experience in a low- or middle-income country would be considered a strong assetWe offer: An interesting and challenging job in a modern research institution with attractive research infrastructures and a cooperative and communicative institute culture. This includes:- **Responsible and diverse: **A position with significant scope for initiative and development within a truly collegial and supportive team- **Fair compensation: **Pay according to the TV-L collective agreement, including annual bonus and company pension scheme- **Family-friendly flexibility: **Flexible working time models, access to a place in our company daycare center, and programs supporting employees returning from parental leave- **Smart commuting: **Excellent connection to the SWB public transport network and the option of an interest-free loan for the purchase of an e-bike- **Supported development: **Individual training opportunities through courses, e-learning programs, and coaching sessions- **Structured onboarding: **A systematic introduction to your new role and team- **Healthy at work: **A wide range of health and wellness programs, plus free membership at the UKB fitness studio- **Employee benefits: **Access to discounted offers for employees (corporate benefits)We are committed to diversity and equal opportunities. Our goal is to increase the proportion of women in areas where women are underrepresented and to particularly promote their careers. We therefore urge relevantly qualified women to apply. Applications are treated in accordance with the State Equal Opportunities Act. Applications from suitable people with proven severe disabilities and those of equal status are particularly welcome.How to apply:If you are seeking a challenging and internationally oriented position within a leading research and clinical environment, we would be pleased to hear from you. For further information, please feel free to contact us.Please submit your complete application documents by 28/02/2026, quoting the vacancy reference number [ST-37032], as a single PDF file (maximum size 5 MB), by email to the address below.English is the working language in many areas of the position; sound knowledge of German is required for administrative issues. Support services for international applicants may be available, including guidance on visa and residence matters as well as initial orientation and integration. Information on dual career options and local infrastructure can be provided upon request.Prof. Dr. med. Andreas Schultz, MSc, DTMPHSektion Global Child Health, Institut für Hygiene und Public HealthUniversitätsklinikum BonnVenusberg-Campus-153127 BonnE-Mail: andreas.schultz@ukbonn.dewww.ukbonn.de

jobs.description: A Snapshot of Your Day As a commodity management professional (f/m/d) you are the strategic procurement owner of the respective commodities within Gas Services Central Service Business. Role requires individual to develop and align a resilient Ecosystem strategy together with commodity circles and in line with global SE strategy and Global Service Operations (GSO & its Regions) objectives. Typical day for Commodity Management professional includes provide and demonstrate supply market knowledge beyond Procurement perspectives to generate value and impact, negotiation with suppliers, supplier relationship management, business case and sourcing strategy preparation/execution, reporting, problem solving, supply chain risk mitigation  as well as alignment meetings with internal/external x-functional team. How You’ll Make an Impact* Develop and execute Comprehensive Commodity Strategies (forward-looking) aimed at achieving business objectives (Growth, Resilience & Cost Out) for Global Service Operations & the Regions * Lead Cross functional Commodity Circle Team that embodies “Value Creation” mindset and drives improvements in cost, on-time delivery, quality, and lead times, while ensuring adequate capacity. The successful candidate will be the strategic leader for assigned commodities.  * Provide strategic vision and represents their respective business interests into a global commodity team. Act as a role model for ownership, innovation, and transformation aligned with Siemens Energy’s values and strategy; Lead and develop assigned team members in commodity. * Works on commodity structure and provide periodic updates of commodity health to Strategic Procurement leadership and key customers, shares supplier market intelligence across Siemens Energy; Define and implement negotiation concepts and strategies to maximize savings; negotiate frame contracts and price lists * Supplier Management: Supplier selection, incl. documentation/onboarding and communication of strategic suppliers. Strategic evaluations, supplier classifications and supplier development to ensure an optimum supply chain.* Handle relationships with strategic suppliers to ensure alignment with company demands, enabling early supplier involvement and driving cost-out initiatives; Identify procurement risks and opportunities through supplier market analysis and scouting, integrating findings into ecosystem strategies for continuous improvement of managed spend.What You Bring* Bachelor's or Master's Degree, or equivalent experience in Business, Supply Chain Management, Engineering or related field; long term of work experience in the procurement area and a proven track record, ideally in a global organization* Strong commercial and technical understanding and knowledge of procurement, project management, and international contract law* Experience in functional leadership and project management is required* Long term experience in multinational Procurement/ Supply Chain function* Fluent language skills in English(primary) and German(secondary) languageAbout the TeamIn our Business Functions we enable our organization to reach their targets by providing best-in class services and solutions in the areas of IT, HR, Finance, Real Estate, Strategy & Technology and more.Who is Siemens Energy? At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation. Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation. Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideoOur Commitment to Diversity Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. Rewards/Benefits* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbaticalWe value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.https://jobs.siemens-energy.com/jobs

jobs.occupation: Sygeplejerske til Hjemmesygeplejen i Halsnæs Kommune
jobs.description:
Får du energi af at arbejde med mennesker, der har mange komplekse sygeplejefaglige problemstillinger? 

Er du god til at holde det faglige overblik og kan du holde en god struktur i dokumentationen? Vi arbejder aktuelt på at styrke vores overblik i dokumentationen og første sygeplejefaglige vurdering. Vi har også fokus på at styrke sygeplejegruppens faglige fællesskab.

Er du god til at være faglig tovholder for borgernes forløb i et tæt tværfagligt samarbejde i faste teams? Hjemmeplejen arbejder aktuelt på samarbejdet i tværfaglige faste teams.

Er du vild med at have stor indflydelse på din vagtplan og kun et lille antal aften- eller nattevagter om måneden?
Hvis du kan se dig selv i noget af dette så læs videre

Vi er en stor gruppe dygtige og dedikerede sygeplejersker, der holder til midt i Frederiksværk i vores eget lille hus. Kom gerne forbi og mærk stemningen hos os.
Hvad kan du få hos os?

• Vi besøger borger en ad gangen og har altid blot den enkelte borger i fokus, enten i sygeplejeklinik eller i borgers hjem.
• Høj grad af selvtilrettelæggelse og indflydelse på daglige arbejdsopgaver – vi har ansvar for  egne borgere som kontaktsygeplejerske.
• En bredt sammensat kollegagruppe - både aldersmæssigt og fagligt - vi er gode til at dele viden med hinanden og bruger hinanden meget på tværs af forskelligheder.
• Løbende vidensdeling/fagligt fokus – og vi investerer i kompetenceudvikling for både den enkelte og for gruppen. ”Hos os sikrer vi en høj og vedvarende faglighed i gruppen, og der er stort fokus på tryghed i at varetage en opgave hos borger. Vi hjælper hinanden med, blandt andet, de borgere som kræver højspecialiseret behandling og pleje." 
• Nærværende og flad ledelsesstruktur hvor der ikke er langt fra idé til handling. Vi fokuserer på det der virker i praksis og har en åben dialog, så samarbejdet er bedst muligt.
• Høj trivsel hos sygeplejegruppen.
• At vi løfter i flok. ”Vi er alle tilknyttet et team af kollegaer, og man er aldrig rigtig ”alene” i den forstand, at man ALTID kan sparre med kollegaer, som har mange års erfaring inden for forskellige specialer, fx sårpleje, palliation, diabetes. 
• Personalegoder: eks. yoga/fitness for 15 kr./mdr. og adgang til booking af sommerhuse. 
• Sociale arrangementer af forskellig karakter: fx bowling, drinksaften, brætspilaften,  sommerfest, vinterbadning, fredagscafé, julefrokost etc. ”Vi vægter det sociale enten i fritiden eller i pauserne”. ”Vi har en god tone og er gode til at grine sammen”.

jobs.occupation: Are you at your best when others are winding down? Join NORMAL's evening team in Hedensted
jobs.description:
A busy warehouse doesn't stop when the afternoon ends and neither does the team at NORMAL's warehouse in Hedensted.

We are looking for reliable and motivated warehouse employees who want to become part of the evening shift.

This job is for you if you enjoy an active workday, like having clear goals and take pride in delivering a stable performance – shift after shift.

You will become part of a team where everyone has an important role. We depend on each other, which means reliability, responsibility and a positive attitude really matter.

What will you be doing?

Your main tasks will include:

• Picking and packing goods using a handheld scanner

• Handling and moving goods throughout the warehouse

• Operating a runner – previous experience is a strong advantage

• Maintaining an efficient and consistent work pace

• Helping your team achieve the evening's targets

The work is physical and the pace is high, so you should enjoy an active job where you are on the move.

What makes a great NORMAL warehouse employee?

It's not only about being fast.

It's about being consistent.

We are looking for colleagues who:

• Show up reliably and are ready to work

• Deliver a stable effort throughout the entire shift

• Are flexible when tasks and priorities change

• Take responsibility for their own work

• Understand and respect performance expectations

• Can receive feedback professionally and use it to improve

• Work efficiently without compromising quality

• Support their colleagues and contribute to the team

Previous warehouse experience, especially within picking and packing, is preferred. Experience operating a runner or similar warehouse equipment is a significant advantage.

You will always know what is expected

NORMAL's warehouse works with clear picking targets and performance expectations.

Productivity and work pace are followed throughout the shift. This creates transparency: you know what is expected, how you are performing and where you can improve.

For the right person, that's motivating.

We expect you to take feedback seriously, take ownership of your performance and work towards delivering consistent results.

In return, you get a workplace with clear expectations and the opportunity to show what you can do.

Your working hours – Evening Shift

Monday – Thursday: 15:00 – 23:00

Friday: 14:30 – 22:00

Your shift includes a 20-minute paid break and a 30-minute unpaid break.

What do we offer?

• DKK 173.60 per hour

• Holiday pay, pension and optional-choice account (Fritvalg)

• Employment according to applicable collective agreements

• An active job where no two shifts feel slow

• Clear goals and ongoing feedback

• Great colleagues and strong teamwork

• Experience from a large and growing company

• Possibility of long-term employment for candidates who consistently perform well

Ready to become part of the evening team?

If you're the person your colleagues can rely on – someone who shows up, stays engaged, takes responsibility and delivers a consistent effort – we want to hear from you.

Apply today and show us what you can bring to the team.

Interviews are held on an ongoing basis.

Working through JKS

As a temporary employee through JKS, you are employed under applicable collective agreements, ensuring fair working conditions and timely salary payments.

Temporary employment also gives you valuable experience and can open the door to permanent opportunities. Many companies recruit directly from their temporary workforce, making this a great opportunity to demonstrate your skills and reliability.

Normal

Hos NORMAL sælger vi helt normale varer til unormale priser. Sortimentet omfatter kendte mærkevarer inden for fx hudpleje, hårpleje, tandpleje, shampoo, makeup og rengøring. Kort sagt: Alle de ting som du ikke kan undvære i din hverdag, og som helst ikke må mangle på hylderne derhjemme. Alle varer sælges til faste, lave priser, og det betyder, at du ikke kan finde slagtilbud og prisbaskere hos os. Til gengæld kan vi love dig, at der er masser af nye og spændende varer på hylderne.

Global Inventory Management Lead

Location: Høje Taastrup, Denmark

Employment type: Full time

Your impact begins here

As Global Inventory Management Lead, you will lead the inventory process within Inbound Global Supplier Operations, ensuring healthy inventory levels that support material availability, operational requirements and working capital objectives.

Working closely with planning teams, procurement, central warehouses and site teams, you will shape forecasting, material segmentation, safety stock and inventory settings. A key part of your impact will be creating an end-to-end inventory cockpit that gives stakeholders one shared view across central and site warehouses and enables coordinated decisions on replenishment, allocation and inventory balancing.

What you'll bring

You bring substantial Supply Chain and inventory management experience together with the ability to provide functional leadership across organisational boundaries. You can turn inventory insights into action, build strong relationships and create the alignment needed to move priorities forward.

• More than 8 years of Supply Chain experience, with demonstrated experience in inventory management and a proven ability to improve inventory performance.

• Demonstrated ability to provide functional leadership and deliver results through cross-functional collaboration and influence.

• Experience leading forecasting processes, material segmentation, and inventory improvement initiatives.

• Strong understanding of safety stock methodologies, replenishment planning, and inventory management across multiple warehouse locations.

• Experience developing inventory dashboards or performance cockpits and translating insights into business actions.

• Strong working knowledge of ERP or planning systems and Microsoft Excel; experience with business intelligence tools is an advantage.

• Ability to balance material availability, operational needs, and working capital objectives.

• Strong communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills.

• Ability to build solid relationships across functions, create alignment, and drive initiatives and decisions forward.

• A structured approach to problem-solving, prioritisation, and performance follow-up.

• CPIM certification preferred.

• A relevant qualification in supply chain management, logistics, business, or a related field is an advantage.

What you'll do

You will take functional leadership of inventory management within Global Supplier Operations. Your responsibilities span the full inventory process and involve close collaboration across Supply Chain:

• Lead the inventory process within Global Supplier Operations, establishing clear standards, priorities, ownership, and performance expectations.

• Lead the forecasting process in close collaboration with planning teams, incorporating material demand, business inputs, and forecast performance.

• Lead material segmentation and translate findings into differentiated inventory and replenishment strategies based on demand patterns, variability, value, and material criticality.

• Define and regularly review safety stock in close collaboration with planning teams, considering demand uncertainty, supplier performance, lead-time variability, and inventory across central and site warehouses.

• Own and continuously improve inventory settings, including reorder points, minimum and maximum stock levels, and replenishment parameters, ensuring they remain aligned with demand and operational requirements.

• Build capability through coaching, knowledge sharing, and consistent application of inventory management practices.

• Create and own an end-to-end inventory cockpit, consolidating inventory, supply and demand data across sites, while aligning stakeholders on common metrics and actions to prevent shortages and reduce slow-moving, excess and obsolete inventory.

Who you'll work with

You will work within Inbound Global Supplier Operations and collaborate closely with planning teams, procurement, central warehouses and site teams across Supply Chain.

Success in this role will depend on your ability to build trusted relationships across these functions and bring different perspectives together. Through the end-to-end inventory cockpit, you will help stakeholders work from a shared view of inventory and turn insights into coordinated decisions on replenishment, stock allocation and inventory balancing across locations.

What you can expect here

This is a functional leadership role with an opportunity to shape inventory management across Supply Chain. You will have the scope to establish consistent practices, create transparency and help teams make better, faster inventory decisions. Your work will support improved material availability, reduced excess and obsolete inventory and better working capital performance.

The Danish Institute for Advanced Study (DIAS) and the Department of Physics, Chemistry and Pharmacy (FKF) at the University of Southern Denmark (SDU) seek an outstanding candidate to fill a tenure track Fellow (Assistant Professor level) position in the field of Medicinal Chemistry or a closely related discipline. The candidate is expected to start on 01.08.2027 or as soon as possible thereafter. 

 

We are looking for a researcher with clear potential for research excellence who thrives in and is inspired by interdisciplinary collaboration. The ideal candidate will be expected to contribute to high-quality research in their field while embracing DIAS’s mission of curiosity-driven inquiry and interdisciplinary dialogue. The successful candidate should have a strong and promising research profile, with potential for attracting external research funding, and a demonstrated ability to work across disciplines. The candidate will be attached to both the Department and DIAS, and should be prepared to engage in multiple and diverse research environments at SDU. Teaching obligations will be reduced compared to a standard assistant professorship at SDU, allowing more time for research, interdisciplinary exchange, active participation in DIAS and leadership activities. 

 

We seek a researcher with expertise in the field of medicinal chemistry, who is eager to develop their research career within the DIAS framework. The researcher should contribute to expanding and strengthening the interface between medicinal chemistry and pharmacy at SDU, fostering interdisciplinary research and collaboration across these fields. Alongside this disciplinary focus, the successful candidate should be intellectually curious about research beyond their immediate field and motivated to participate in DIAS’s wider cross-faculty community.

 

We particularly welcome applicants whose research combines medicinal chemistry disciplines with pharmaceutical sciences, including drug delivery, formulation, biopharmaceutics, or translational drug development. We are especially interested in researchers who can establish innovative research directions that connect molecular drug design and optimization with pharmaceutical development and therapeutic translation. The ideal candidate should demonstrate: 

 

• 
A commitment to engaging in boundary-crossing interdisciplinary research and dialogue.

• 
A strong commitment to interdisciplinary collaboration, contributing to research that bridges multiple fields. 

• 
A strong interest in driving internationally competitive research activities at the highest level of ambition. 

• 
Active engagement in various forms of research dissemination, including interdisciplinary research and dialogue. 

• 
The ability to communicate project results in English both in writing in academic contexts and to the broader public.

• 
The ability to teach and supervise students.

 

Qualifications

Successful applicants must: 

• 
Hold a PhD or similar qualifications within relevant fields of medicinal chemistry, chemical biology and pharmacy (to qualify for the position as Assistant Professor you must have obtained a PhD or similar degree by the application deadline). 

• 
Exhibit curiosity-driven research excellence, thinking beyond traditional boundaries. 

• 
Be fluent in English.

• 
Show potential for attracting external research funding. Experience in applying for external funding and a strong international network are considered comparative advantages.

• 
Have research publications that demonstrate their excellence and broad thinking. 

• 
Be an inspiring and engaging teacher and supervisor.

The Danish Institute for Advanced Study (DIAS)

DIAS at SDU is a hub for interdisciplinary excellence at and beyond the frontier of knowledge, bringing together outstanding researchers from various disciplines to foster groundbreaking interdisciplinary research and bold innovation. DIAS nurtures a collaborative and curiosity-driven environment, encouraging scholars to think outside the box and challenge conventional boundaries. The institute values open-minded exploration and an ambitious yet collegial atmosphere with a strong sense of community. DIAS fellows become members of the DIAS Society of Fellows, which supports research, networking, and leadership opportunities while fostering a sense of community among early-career researchers from diverse disciplines. The Society provides guidance and support to all Fellows, ensuring they feel welcome and integrated. DIAS also offers Blue Sky Mentoring. Together, these provide support for fellows’ development and integration into the DIAS community. Researchers affiliated with DIAS are expected to contribute actively to DIAS activities, and engage in interdisciplinary collaborations across faculties and departments, both nationally and internationally.  

 

The Department

At the Department of Physics, Chemistry and Pharmacy, we contribute to solving some of society’s greatest challenges within energy, environment, health, and sustainability. We succeed because we build bridges between disciplines and transcend traditional boundaries. Our interdisciplinary mindset is not only a fundamental condition, but also our strength. And it is a strength that ensures our research and education are recognized both nationally and internationally.

 

Our vision is to create and apply knowledge across the natural sciences. We are unique in housing research within physics, chemistry, and pharmacy under one department, which provides excellent opportunities to explore the intersections between these disciplines.

 

But we go further. At SDU, we collaborate with researchers from IMADA (Department of Mathematics and Computer Science) to advance fields towards digital transformation. We work with IGT (Department of Green Technology) and MMI (Maersk Mc-Kinney Møller Institute) to harness the potential at the intersection of research and technological application. We also collaborate with researchers from the Faculty of Health Sciences to integrate health-related perspectives.

 

Additional information

For further information about being a fellow at DIAS, please contact DIAS director Sten Rynning at +45 6550 2193 or via email at director-dias@sdu.dk. 

 

For more questions about the position please contact Head of Department Professor Jacob Kongsted, email: kongsted@sdu.dk. 

 

Application, salary, and employment terms

The position is based at the Department of Physics, Chemistry and Pharmacy in Odense and includes regular participation in DIAS and interdisciplinary collaboration.

Employment is governed by the collective agreement between the Danish Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations (AC). 

The salary comprises a seniority-based base salary and a centrally agreed supplement.

Additional supplements may be negotiated locally.

As of 1 August 2026, the annual salary for an Assistant Professor is DKK 480,224.96 (salary level 6), consisting of a base salary of DKK 417,456 and a supplement of DKK 62,768.96.

All amounts are stated before tax, before added pension (18.07%), and any additional supplements. Pension contributions are paid by SDU, and both salary components (the annual salary and the supplement) are pensionable. For more details on salary and taxation, please refer to the provided links about salary and taxation. International researchers may be eligible for the Danish Researcher Tax Scheme, which can offer favourable tax conditions. SDU can provide information and guidance regarding the scheme.

 

Danish Tenure Track Programme

An appointment as Assistant Professor (Danish tenure track) is limited to a six-year term. The academic assessment for promotion to Associate Professor must be initiated no later than the end of the fifth year of employment. However, a tenure track assistant professor may request an earlier assessment within the first four years.

If the initial assessment is negative, one reassessment may be conducted during the final six months prior to a potential transition. A maximum of two assessments may be undertaken.

A positive assessment leads to appointment to a permanent Associate Professor position. If the final assessment is negative, the employment may be terminated in accordance with the applicable collective agreement.

A six-year development plan for the tenure track programme is established at the start of employment.

 

Application requirements
The application must include the following:

• 
Letter of motivation that clearly explains the applicant's interest, qualifications, and motivation for the position.

• 
Detailed CV including documentation of experience, and contacts for possible references. 

• 
An elaborated research and funding plan (max 4 pages) for the next three years, including a description of synergy with the department's activities and how the applicant’s research could benefit from DIAS’s interdisciplinary environment. Applicants should also explain, in their letter of motivation, how they would contribute to DIAS’s intellectual community and engage with researchers beyond their immediate field. 

• 
Copies of certificates/Diplomas (Master and PhD degree).

• 
Complete list of publications, indicating which publications are most relevant for the position.

• 
Up to 5 of the most relevant research articles – if you submit a monograph, it counts as 3 articles. Please upload a pdf for each publication. For co-authored publications, briefly describe the extent of the co-authorship or your contribution to the publications (please do this for each co-authored publication). You can do so by using this form or by describing the co-authorship in such a way that the committee can assess the extent of your contribution.

• 
Applicants are requested to submit a teaching portfolio with the application as documentation for teaching experience as well as supervision qualifications. Formal application instructions and a guide for the teaching portfolio can be found here.

All application materials must be submitted in English, and only applications written in English will be considered.

We recommend that international applicants take the time to visit websites of Work in Denmark and the International Staff Office at SDU. Here you can find information and facts about moving to, working and living in Denmark.

Application deadline: 25.02.2027
